milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate gravel. The gravel patch is centered at (6.5, -1, 6.5) spawn-relative, which is ~9.2 blocks from spawn. max_distance=6 requires the player to actually walk toward the gravel patch (they must be within 6 horizontal blocks of the center). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the gravel, confirming they found it.

Uses inventory_has because mining sandstone_wall with a pickaxe drops the sandstone_wall item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no sandstone_wall in inventory (only a wooden pickaxe is given), so having at least 1 sandstone_wall confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

Uses position_inside_box because the sand pit at (13-15, -5 to -3, -2 to 8) spawn-relative is ONLY reachable by falling from the structure top — it is enclosed by sand walls on 3 sides and the sandstone structure wall on the 4th side, with no walking path into it. The pit floor is at y=-5 and the structure top is at y=3, creating a 7-block fall. Being inside this box proves the player fell from the structure. The box is generous vertically (-5 to -3) to catch the player at any point in the pit.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate lily pads on the pond. The lily pads are clustered around (-6, 0, -6) spawn-relative on the water pond surface. max_distance=10 requires the player to navigate toward the pond (it's ~8.5 blocks from spawn, so they must move in that direction). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the lily pads, confirming visual discovery.
